# Tarek Ahmed, AEC Software Engineer

> A civil engineer turned software engineer who builds the software that AEC (Architecture,
> Engineering & Construction) teams rely on: Autodesk plugins (Revit, Civil 3D, AutoCAD,
> Navisworks), Autodesk Platform Services (APS, formerly Forge) and Autodesk Construction Cloud
> (ACC/BIM 360) integrations, and enterprise web platforms in C#/.NET, Blazor, ASP.NET Core, and
> React/TypeScript. Based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Currently a Senior AEC Software Engineer at
> LTIMindtree on the Qiddiya gigaproject; founder of TA Solutions, whose commercial plugins have
> passed 1,000+ installs on the Autodesk App Store at a 5.0 average rating.

## Specialties
- Autodesk plugin development: Revit API, Civil 3D API, AutoCAD API, Navisworks API (C#/.NET, WPF/MVVM)
- Autodesk Platform Services (APS/Forge) and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC/BIM 360) integrations: OAuth, Data Management, Issues APIs
- Enterprise web platforms: Blazor, ASP.NET Core, React, TypeScript, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core
- Engineering automation and digital engineering for the AEC/BIM industry

## Selected projects
- TA Roads Toolkit: Civil 3D plugin that automates 25+ road-design workflows; 567+ App Store installs across four major releases, with V5 in development.
- Docs Uploader: Windows desktop client that bulk-uploads folder trees to Autodesk Construction Cloud on the APS Data Management API, with per-file retryable state; uploads direct to ACC so deep paths never hit the Windows path limit that ruled out Desktop Connector. In production at Kemet Corporation.
- Elsewedy Busway: Revit plugin taking busway networks from design to fabrication with a catalog-backed product model and a sketch/fabrication dual representation.
- PoE: Revit add-in with a typed node-based schematic editor bound to the Revit model.
- Docs Archive: Windows service performing incremental sync of ACC data to a local mirror.
